feature: Add skeleton loading states for data-heavy pages
workflow_rationale: This is a straightforward UI enhancement that only affects frontend components in a single service (minside). No backend changes, no API modifications, no complex dependencies. Each page can be updated independently with skeleton loading patterns.

phases.name: Skeleton Loading Implementation
phases.description: Replace Spinner loading indicators with Skeleton components on dashboard, bookings, and settings pages

implementation_notes: Import Skeleton from @xala/ds (already exported, no need to modify ds package)
Replace isLoading Spinner at lines 321-324 with skeleton layout matching:
- 3 stats cards: Icon circle skeleton + Label skeleton + Number skeleton
- 4 quick action cards: Icon skeleton + Label skeleton
- Upcoming bookings list: 5 booking item skeletons with icon, title, date, price
Match existing spacing (var(--ds-spacing-X)) and responsive isMobile patterns
Ensure skeleton layout matches actual content structure to prevent layout shift
